app.title: Show HN: I wrote a custom assembler for CHIP-8 in C++
app.author: tack1234
app.description: A command‑line CHIP‑8 assembler written in C++, producing binary ROMs for CHIP‑8 interpreters.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `make` to build the `c8-ass` binary.
Create a minimal CHIP‑8 program file (e.g., `HELLO.C8`) and assemble it with `c8-ass HELLO.C8 output.c8`.
Verify that the output binary is the expected size (e.g., 0x200 bytes) and contains the correct opcode sequence.
Run `c8-ass --help` and confirm that the help text appears and the program exits with code 0.
